headline: Real Estate tops the 60/40 diversifier list, but only on its smoothed volatility
takeaway: Why: Gradient assumes Real Estate earns 5.44% over cash at 11.0% volatility; at Gradient’s policy-channel volatility (18.1%) it no longer improves the ratio. Government Bonds (1.95% premium, −0.04 correlation with developed equity) improve it on either basis. Commodities cost the most: a 0.88% premium for 22.9% volatility.
